etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from French récalcitrant, in derived from Latin recalcitrāns, recalcitrantis, present participle of recalcitrō, recalcitrāre (“be disobedient, kick back [as a horse]”), from calx (“heel”), 1820s.
senses: Marked by a stubborn unwillingness to obey authority.
